text:
kevin: Quick heads-up: onboarding Hydra's LoRA (cust-hydra). Did a stitch-merge + int4-pack sanity run and saw rerank order flips and a repeated placeholder token mid-response. tagging @sara @mina.

sara: Can you paste a failing example and the token diff?

kevin: Example prompt that misbehaves:
User: Outline a 4-step QA checklist for cold-chain pickups.
Assistant (fp16): Step 1: verify seals. Step 2: check temps. Step 3: log readings. Step 4: confirm signatures.
Assistant (int4): Step 1: verify seals. Step 2: <PLACEHOLDER> Step 2: <PLACEHOLDER> Step 3: log readings.

mina: Yikes. That placeholder repeat suggests either a tokenizer token id collision or KV-cache mis-indexing. Any kernel warnings in the logs?

kevin: CI quickpack: /ci/12077 model-merge-smoke triggered. Result: 10/12 smoke checks passed. Fails: rerank_flip_03, repeated_placeholder_01. Logs: /ci/12077/logs.

rob: token-diff snippet I pulled quickly:
PROMPT TOKENS (base): [11, 234, 77, 900, 45, 333, ...]
PROMPT TOKENS (merged): [11, 234, 77, 900, 45, 40001, ...]  # extra id 40001 at pos 6

sara: Does adapter introduce custom tokens? Hydra mentioned shorthand markers in their dataset. If merge appends instead of remapping to reserved slots, offsets happen.

kevin: Repro command I used:
```bash
rwi eval --customer hydra --adapter hydra-lora-v1 \
  --merge stitch --quant int4-pack-B --suites instruction,rerank,regress --seed 5
# quick metrics: rerank_auc_down: 0.04, avg_resp_len_delta: -9%, repeat_rate:+12%
```

mina: Two-pronged triage suggestion:
1) Tokenizer delta: run tokenizer.compare and regenerate mapping with keep_reserved, then re-merge with --force-remap.
2) KV-cache isolation: run inference with --disable-kv-cache to see if repetition disappears.

rob: Also try adapter-rescale sweep (0.6,0.7) and an int8-pack compare. Sometimes kernel packing amplifies small tokenization shifts.

ci-bot: /ci/12078: remap+sweep started (force-remap={yes,no}, rescale={0.6,0.7}, pack={int4-pack-B,int8}). Will post matrix at /ci/12078/results.json.

sara: Contingency plan: if int4 can't stabilize quickly we should pin Hydra to fp16 merged on their dedicated route and enable a manual opt-in canary. Ops, can you prepare rollback commands?

ops-bot: Rollback/runbook draft created at /ops/runbooks/hydra-rollback.txt. Contains commands to pin model route and toggle quant canary.

kevin: Quick test I did locally: disable KV-cache -> repeated placeholder disappears and rerank delta drops by half. That strongly implicates a cache index mismatch.

mina: Good signal. Next steps I propose:
- Run tokenizer.compare(base, adapter, merged) to confirm token id insertions.
- If adapter adds tokens, regenerate mapping with keep_reserved and re-run merge with force-remap.
- Add a head-map + kv-index dump during CI to detect misalignments.
- If remap + rescale (0.6) passes, prepare canary for Hydra and monitor rerank AUC closely.

rob: I'll open GH issue with traces + token dumps and attach the repro script. Will link here.

kevin: Thanks 1. I'll follow up with small per-example diffs and CI matrix when /ci/12078 finishes.

sara: Perfect. If anyone pairs on KV debug, ping me. :eyes:

ci-bot: /ci/12078: sweep partial results posted. remap=yes + rescale=0.6 + int4-pack-B -> repeated_placeholder fixed on 9/10, rerank_delta within threshold. Full matrix: /ci/12078/results.json

kevin: Nice. Will run a larger holdout overnight and share final summary tomorrow. If stable, we do a canary on dedicated with fallback to fp16.

sara: Thanks team. Closing loop later. :thumbsup:
